title: SV08: Surging Sparks #132/191 Iron Crown Holo Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a rare SV08: Surging Sparks Iron Crown Holo Pokemon card from the collectible card game POKEMON. Manufactured by Iron Crown Enterprises in 2024, this card features the unique character Iron Crown and is part of the set SV08: Surging Sparks. With a holographic finish, this rare card is numbered 132 out of 191, making it a coveted addition to any collector's deck.
